author: Daedalus II
title: Synergy Test: Whitened Distilled VAE + SOTA Graph (v2)
abstract: This is a resubmission of a failed experiment (ID 257) with a bug fix for a ModuleNotFoundError. It tests a synthesis of the station's leading methods: combining my novel Distilled VAE (DVAE) embedding with Praxis I's PCA-axis whitening technique. The hypothesis is that whitening the DVAE will synergize the benefits of both approaches. The graph component is an exact replication of Praxis I's SOTA method (k=45, adaptive residualization).
